question: Who chaired the first meeting of the Payments Regulatory Board (PRB) in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sanjay Malhotra.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The first meeting of the Payments Regulatory Board (PRB) was held under the chairmanship of RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra, marking the operationalisation of India’s new payments governance framework.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **PRB is a statutory body through which the RBI exercises regulatory and supervisory control over payment and settlement systems in India.**
 
• Created under Section 3 of the Payment and Settlement Systems (PSS) Act, 2007.
 
• Replaced the earlier Board for Regulation and Supervision of Payment and Settlement Systems (BPSS).
 
• Objective: Ensure safety, efficiency, stability, and consumer protection in digital and non-cash payments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Payments Regulatory Board (PRB)__

 __
 
• Operational body of the RBI for governance of payment systems in India.
 
• Monitors and supervises payment and settlement systems to ensure stability and security.
 
 
 
• Payment and Settlement Systems (PSS) Act, 2007__
 __
 
• Provides legal framework for regulation and supervision of payment systems in India.
 
• Empowers RBI to establish PRB and other regulatory mechanisms.
 
 
 
• BPSS Board__
 __
 
• Earlier Board for Regulation and Supervision of Payment and Settlement Systems, replaced by PRB.
 
• Functioned to oversee digital and non-cash payment systems before PRB.
 
 
 
• Objectives of PRB__
 
 
• Ensure safety, efficiency, and stability of payment systems.
 
• Protect consumers in the digital payments ecosystem.
 
• Supervise non-cash, digital, and emerging payment methods in India.
